name: Archmage
description: Whenever you cast an ability, refund the cooldown of another, randomly selected ability by 30% of the casted ability's cooldown.

name: Back to Basics
description: Your champion abilities deal 35% increased damage and you gain 70 ability haste and 35% increased healing and shielding from all sources, but your ultimate ability is permanently sealed.

name: Big Shot
description: Convert 75% of your total attack speed into critical strike damage, at a rate of 0.67% critical strike damage per 1% attack speed. Additionally, you gain 25% bonus attack damage and 35% critical strike damage.

name: Biggest Snowball Ever
description:
Upgrades your Mark into a massive snowball, empowering it with an increased size radius and the ability to pass through non-champions. The snowball additionally explodes upon impact of the target hit to deal 200 – 350 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies, knock them up for 0.75 seconds, and slow them by 20% for 2 seconds. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark. Non-champions hit by the snowball are stunned for 1.25 seconds.

name: Blade Waltz
description:
Replace a summoner spell with Blade Waltz.
Blade Waltz: Blink to the target enemy champion. You then blink to the nearest other enemy champion every 0.25 seconds over the next 1.75 seconds, blinking up to 7 additional times. The last blink targets the primary target. Each time you blink to an enemy, deal 30 – 150 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) physical damage to them and apply on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness, up to a total of 180 – 900 (based on level) (+ 60% bonus AD) (+ 36% AP) (45 second cooldown).
While Blade Waltz is active, you are untargetable and unable to act. This effect will end prematurely if there are no longer any nearby valid targets to blink to. An enemy can be blinked to more than once if there are no other valid targets in range.

name: Bouncing Bees
description:
After casting an ability, your next basic attack is empowered to bounce a bee from the primary target to the nearest enemy champion within 700 units of them, dealing 50% – 100% (based on level) of the triggering attack's damage upon arrival.
Additionally, you are assigned with quests that require you to bounce bees onto enemy champions a number of times. There are three quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with bonus attack damage and an additional bee bounce on the empowered attack that repeats from the new target with each bounce, forming a chain of bee attacks.
Tier
Quest
Reward
1
Bounce bees onto enemy champions 10 times.
Gain 30 bonus attack damage and an additional bee bounce.
(2 bounces total)

Bounce bees onto enemy champions 30 more times (40 bounces total).
Gain 30 bonus attack damage and an additional bee bounce.
(total 60 bonus attack damage and 3 bounces)

Gain 30 bonus attack damage and an additional bee bounce.

name: Can't Touch This
description: Casting your ultimate grants you invulnerability for 2 seconds (8 second cooldown).

name: Circle of Death
description: Healing and health regeneration you do causes you to deal 70% of that value in magic damage to the nearest enemy champion within 1000 units.

name: Clown College
description:
Gain Shaco's Backstab, Deceive and Hallucinate's explosion. Replace a summoner spell with Deceive.
Passive - Backstab: Your basic attacks deal 20 – 35 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 35% AP) bonus physical damage on-hit when hitting an enemy from behind.
Active - Deceive: Become invisible for up to 3 seconds and blink to the target location within 400 units after a 0.125-second delay. Your next basic attack while in stealth deals 100 (+ 150% bonus AD) (+ 55% AP) bonus physical damage, increased to「 155 (+ 232.5% bonus AD) (+ 85.25% AP) bonus physical damage 」「 155% damage 」if Backstab was applied (45 second cooldown).
Passive - Hallucinate Death: Upon your death, release an explosion in a 350 radius of your death location, dealing true damage equal to 25% of target's maximum health to enemies within the area. Additionally, you deploy a box at the location of your death that instantly fears nearby enemies for 1 second. This box does not attack but lasts for 3 seconds.

name: Courage of the Colossus
description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants a shield for 3 seconds that absorbs 150 – 450 (based on level) (+ 4% maximum health) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields.

name: Cruelty
description:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion summons a comet above them that lands at their current location after 1 second, dealing 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% AP) (+ 4% of your maximum health) magic damage to enemies within a 300 radius (6 second cooldown per cast instance).
For displacement effects, the comet will be summoned at the displacement's end location.

name: Dashing
description:
Abilities with dashes or blinks gain 175 ability haste.
On Kalista, this augment instead grants her 125% bonus attack speed.[1]
notes: • On {{ci|Kalista}}, this augment instead grants her 125% bonus attack speed.[https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Tnm4B6E5a]

name: Double Tap
description: Basic attacks that critically strike apply on-hit effects an additional time. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

name: Draw Your Sword
description:
Become melee, modifying your attack range to 200 (+ 100% bonus attack range from augments) units. Additionally, gain 24% bonus attack damage, 20% bonus attack speed, 24% bonus health, 20% bonus movement speed, and 20% life steal. These bonuses are increased by 0% – 100% (based on champion's default attack range).
This augment is only available for ranged champions.
This augment is not offered if the champion has built Runaan's Hurricane.
notes: • This augment is not offered if the champion has built Runaan's Hurricane.

name: Dual Wield
description: Your basic attacks launch a bolt at the target that fires after a 0.225-second delay on-attack, deals 40% of the triggering attack's pre-mitigation damage, and applies on-hit effects at 40% effectiveness. Additionally, increase your total attack speed by 10%.

name: Earthwake
description:
Dashing or blinking causes you to leave behind a trail from the location you moved to your destination that detonates after 0.75 seconds in a 300 radius, dealing 90 – 250 (based on level) (+ 125% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) physical damage per explosion to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against minions. Enemies can be affected only once every second from all cast instances, and the effect is not triggered if you move beyond 2000 units with the dash or blink.
This augment is only offered to up to 2 players on each team for a given game.

name: Echo Cast
description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to summon a clone of your champion that is untargetable and moves up to 500 units towards your cursor. The clone then casts the ability it was summoned from after a 0.25-second delay, mimicking the active effects of the casted spell and disappearing after it finishes casting.
Clone movement speed is 1000.
Clone has a maximum lifetime of 7 seconds.
notes:
• Clone movement speed is 1000.
• Clone has a maximum lifetime of 7 seconds.

name: Empowered By The Faithful
description: Granting a heal or shield to an allied champion blesses them for 8 seconds. Whenever a blessed ally damages an enemy champion, you generate a stack of Devotion, stacking up to 50 times. Upon reaching maximum stacks, you unleash a shockwave that expands from your location in a massive radius and deals 50 – 300 (based on level) (+ 750% heal and shield power) magic damage to enemies hit. Enemy champions damaged below a percentage of their maximum health equal to 25% of your heal and shield power are executed.

name: Empyrean Promise
description:
Replace a summoner spell with Empyrean Promise's Vigilance active. Additionally, gain 15% heal and shield power.
Active - Vigilance: After a 0.25-second delay, dash to the current location of the target allied champion and gain a 100 – 250 (based on level) (+ 100% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield for 3 seconds. Upon arrival, grant the ally the same shield (20 second cooldown; 2000 range).

name: En Passant
description:
You can now identify the Vitals of enemy champions within 2000 units, marked as an arc around them and pointing towards a specific direction. Dealing damage to a target with a basic attack or ability while you are facing in the direction of their exposed Vital will consume it, dealing bonus true damage equal to 6% (+ 1.5% per En Passant stack) of the target's maximum health, healing you for 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 5% missing health), and granting you 50% (+ 5% per En Passant stack) bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. Consuming a target's Vital also grants you an En Passant stack for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent Vital triggers and stacking up a number of times. Each En Passant stack increases the consumed Vital damage and bonus movement speed.
Vitals on targets become exposed instantly once you are within range and remain exposed until you die. Once a target's Vital is consumed, you identify a new Vital on them pointing in a different direction from the previous after 4 seconds.

name: Eureka
description: Gain ability haste equal to 30% AP.

name: Fey Magic
description: Damaging enemies with your ultimate ability polymorphs them into harmless critters for 2 seconds, during which their base movement speed is reduced by 60, and disarms them for the same duration (15 second cooldown per target).

name: Final Form
description: Casting your ultimate ability empowers you for 10 seconds, causing you to gain a shield for 50% of your maximum health, 20% omnivamp, and 30% bonus movement speed for the duration (20 second cooldown).

name: Giant Slayer
description: Become tiny, reducing your size by 75% and granting you 20% bonus movement speed. Additionally, deal 10% / 15% / 25% / 30% (based on target's size) bonus damage against enemy champions with greater size than you.

name: Glass Cannon
description: You gain a health threshold equal to 70% maximum health which cannot be modified nor exceeded by any means. In return, you deal bonus true damage equal to ( 25% / 15%) of all of the damage you deal pre-mitigation.

name: Goldrend
description: Damaging basic attacks or abilities against enemy champions deal 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage, and grant you 30 and 25% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds (30 second cooldown per champion).

name: Goliath
description: Grants 35% bonus health, 15% adaptive force, and 50% increased size.

name: Group Hug
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that can target allied champions and has a heal or shield effect, empowering the ability's cast to also target two of the closest allied champions within 500 units of the primary target.

name: Hand of Baron
description: Gain a modified Hand of Baron, which only grants 25% increased adaptive force and greatly empowers nearby allied minions.

name: Hellbent
description:
Generate a stack of Revivemaxxing for each enemy champion you hit with basic attacks on-hit or abilities, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 10 times. At maximum stacks, you become Hellbent.
Hellbent: Upon taking lethal damage, you enter resurrection for 4 seconds, during which you are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act. Afterwards, you revive with 35% – 75% (based on level) of your maximum health (90 second cooldown). Additionally, you become empowered for the next 15 seconds, granting you 15 – 120 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 25 – 200 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive), 20% – 40% (based on level) bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby enemy champions, and 15% – 30% (based on level) omnivamp for the duration.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Holy Snowball
description:
After using the Dash spell from Mark, you become invulnerable for 1.5 seconds upon arrival. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

name: Infernal Conduit
description:
Your ability hits against champions apply a Burn for 3 seconds that deals「 2 – 20 (based on level) (+ 4.6% bonus AD) (+ 2% AP) bonus magic damage per second 」「 6 – 60 (based on level) (+ 14% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) bonus magic damage over the duration 」(1 second cooldown per cast instance). This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.
Additionally, all of your Burn effects reduce the cooldowns of all your basic abilities by 0.08 seconds for each tick of damage they deal to a target.
Damage over time effects from all sources except items(unexpected) count as Burn sources for triggering the cooldown reduction.
Eligible Augments for Burn: Firebrand, Infernal Conduit, Pressure Cooker
notes:
• Damage over time effects from all sources except items{{bug|2}} count as Burn sources for triggering the cooldown reduction.
• {{sbc|Eligible Augments for Burn}}: Firebrand, Infernal Conduit, Pressure Cooker

name: Infinite Recursion
description: Gain 60 ability haste, increased by 3 each time you score a champion takedown.

name: Jeweled Gauntlet
description:
Your abilities can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical strike damage) damage. Additionally, gain 25% (+ 4.5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance.
If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).
The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects.(bug)
Jeweled Gauntlet has no effect on abilities that can already critically strike.
notes:
• The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects.{{bug}}
• Jeweled Gauntlet has no effect on abilities that can already critically strike.

name: King Me
description:
Upon entering the enemy team's gate or Catapult for the first time, either of which are located near their spawn, you become Kinged, causing you to gain one random Prismatic-tier augment and the first eligible Legendary item in your inventory to be upgraded with improved stats. The gold value of all upgradeable stats on the item is increased by exactly 1000.
King Me scans each item slot in the champion's inventory (from slots 1-6) for an eligible Legendary item, upgrading the first eligible item that is found.

name: Mad Scientist
description: Upon acquiring this augment and each time you respawn, gain either 30% adaptive force, 20% bonus health, and 40% increased size or 70 ability haste, 40% bonus movement speed, and 40% reduced size.

name: Master of Duality
description: Basic attacks on-hit grant 6 – 18 (based on level) ability power and damaging abilities once per cast instance grant 3 – 9 (based on level) bonus attack damage, lasting for 5 seconds, with the duration of both refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking infinitely.

name: Mosh Monster
description: Casting your ultimate ability grants you 300 – 750 (based on level) bonus health on-cast and slows enemies within 350 units of you by 50% while it is active. Additionally, scoring a takedown against an enemy champion permanently increases the bonus health gained by 15 – 30 (based on level) and expands the radius of the slow, tripled if the takedown was scored while your ultimate was active.

name: Multishot
description:
Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability's missile a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are six quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with an additional missile fired on the ability's cast. The reward effect also modifies the ability to fire all of its missiles in a cone. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.
Hit requirements as denoted below are rounded down to whole numbers, with a minimum value of 1.
Tier
Quest
Reward
1
Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (50 ÷ Ability's Base CD) times.
Ability fires an additional missile.
(2 missiles total)

Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (250 ÷ Ability's Base CD) more times.
Ability fires an additional missile.
(3 missiles total)

Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (700 ÷ Ability's Base CD) more times.

Hit an enemy champion with the ability's missile (2000 ÷ Ability's Base CD) more times.

Ability fires an additional missile.

Ability fires an additional missile.
(7 missiles total)

name: Mystic Punch
description: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the remaining cooldowns of your abilities by 1.25 seconds.

name: Ominous Pact
description: Your abilities now have a health cost of 5% current health to cast them. In return, you gain ability power based on your missing health, up to 75 – 150 (based on level) at 70% missing health, 0% – 50% (based on missing health) bonus movement speed, and 0% – 20% (based on missing health) omnivamp.

name: Omni Soul
description: Grants 3 random Dragon Souls.

name: Overloaded
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to have its cooldown reset whenever you cast a different ability.

name: Pandora's Box
description: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment. Additionally, your current augments transform into an equal number of completely random Prismatic-tier ones.

name: Pin Cushion
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, empowering it to cause basic attacks during the ability's effect to apply Nail stacks against enemy champions. At the end of the ability's duration, or if you die, the stacks on all targets are consumed, dealing 20 – 60 (based on level) physical damage per Nail stack on the target. If this effect would deal lethal damage to the target, the stacks are consumed immediately. Additionally, once a target's stacks are consumed, you gain 10 bonus movement speed per consumed stack for 3 seconds.

name: Prom Queen
description:
Automatically cast a modified version of Rakan's The Quickness, empowering you to break into a captivating sprint for 6 seconds. While empowered, you gain ghosting and 50% bonus movement speed, and enemies you collide with are knocked down and become charmed for 1.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).
A sparkly tiara will descend upon you 2.5 seconds before the effect activates.

name: Protein Shake
description: Gain 25% (+ 35% per 100 bonus armor) (+ 35% per 100 bonus magic resistance) heal and shield power.

name: Quest: Icathia's Fall
description:
Gain Bami's Cinder. You can now purchase Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis in spite of the item limit imposed by Immolate.
Quest: Obtain Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis.
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Void Immolation.
While you have Void Immolation, you will be imposed with Immolate's item limit.
When gaining Bami's Cinder, you will lose an Ruby Crystal or a Glowing Mote in your inventory as it will get upgraded with no gold returned back to you.(bug)
notes:
• While you have Void Immolation, you will be imposed with {{nie|Immolate's}} item limit.
• When gaining Bami's Cinder, you will lose an Ruby Crystal or a Glowing Mote in your inventory as it will get upgraded with no gold returned back to you.{{bug}}

name: Quest: Sneakerhead
description:
Assigns quests that require you to perform specific tasks while equipped with a particular Boots item, which is granted to you for free during its respective quest. Finish the following quests, which are assigned to you in a random order:
Quest - Berserker's Greaves: Basic attack 25 times.
Quest - Boots of Swiftness: Run 300 steps.
Quest - Ionian Boots of Lucidity: Cast 20 abilities.
Quest - Mercury's Treads: Become afflicted by crowd control 5 times.
Quest - Plated Steelcaps: Reduce a total of 200 damage with Plating.
Quest - Sorcerer's Shoes: Deal a total of 1500 damage with abilities.
Reward: Upon completing all of the above quests, you receive Jarvan I's.
You cannot purchase any Boots items while equipped with this augment. If you already have a Boots item, it is replaced by the Boots granted by this effect. Boots items gained from this effect cannot be sold.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Quest: Urf's Champion
description:
Quest: Score 18 champion takedowns.
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, you receive The Golden Spatula.
If your inventory is full at the time of quest completion, the item will be granted as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.
The Golden Spatula

Ability power changed to 110.
Attack speed changed to 40%.

name: Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap
description:
Gain a Needlessly Large Rod.
Quest: Obtain Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass.
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Wooglet's Witchcap.
Wooglet's Witchcap
Stasis cooldown changed to 60 seconds.
notes:
• Wooglet's Witchcap
• * Stasis cooldown changed to 60 seconds.

name: RISE
description: Your ultimate ability now gains a recast for 5 seconds if it scores the killing blow on an enemy champion. This may occur up to 2 times from the ultimate's initial cast, for a total of two recasts. The recast mimics the active effects of the ultimate ability as it was initially cast, but causes it to also deal 25% more damage than the previous cast.

name: Rite of Ascension
description: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them causes them to leave behind their Essence for 8 seconds. You can basic attack the Essence within 400 units to consume it: causing you to blink to its location after winding up for 1.25 seconds, during which you are untargetable (except to turrets), displacement immune, and unable to act. Upon consumption of the Essence, you gain 100% bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds, heal yourself for 75 – 300 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP), and reset the cooldowns of your basic abilities. The heal is increased by 0% – 100% (based on your missing health), for a maximum heal of 150 – 600 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP).

name: Scopiest Weapons
description: Gain ( 250 / 150) bonus attack range.

name: Spell Split
description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a missile, empowering the ability's missile to split in two over 0.25 seconds upon reaching maximum range, or when recast. Each of the split missiles fire perpendicularly in opposite directions and apply the same effects to enemies they hit. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.
Recast can be used after 0.15 seconds of the initial cast.

name: Spirit Bomb
description:
Your healing and shielding on yourself or allies builds up a Spirit Bomb on top of you. Once you have healed and shielded a combined total of 200 – 2000 (based on level), you toss the Spirit Bomb onto the most wounded allied champion over 1.1 seconds. Upon impact, the Spirit Bomb explodes in a 475 radius to heal allied champions within the area for 5% – 15% (based on level) (+ 3% per 100 AP) of their missing health and grants them a shield for 2 seconds that absorbs damage equal to 10% – 25% (based on level) (+ 2% per 100 AP) of their current health.
Healing and shielding from this effect do not count toward the Spirit Bomb's trigger condition.
This augment is currently disabled.
The toss range for the Spirit Bomb is global; it will target the lowest-health ally on the map.
notes: • The toss range for the Spirit Bomb is global; it will target the lowest-health ally on the map.

name: Squishy Slappy Grab
description:
When an enemy champion is within 450 units of you, after a 1.5-second delay, you send out Squishy Slappy Hands that latch onto all nearby enemy champions within 800 units, forming a tether between yourself and each target for 4 seconds (30 second cooldown). While the tethers persist (950 tether radius), your next basic attack is empowered to pull all tethered enemies toward you, dealing 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 15% bonus health) magic damage to affected targets and stunning them for 0.25 seconds after the pull ends. Targets are pulled over 450 units, reduced to 350 for those farther away from you. Additionally, you gain a 100 – 300 (based on level) (+ 70% bonus armor) (+ 70% bonus magic resistance) shield for each pulled enemy, lasting for 2.5 seconds.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
description: Gain 4 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils. Additionally, on the next round of augment selection, you gain an additional reroll per augment slot.

name: Stuck in Here With Me
description:
Casting your ultimate ability grants you an aura for 2 seconds, growing in size over the duration to up to 500 units. After the duration, you taunt all enemies within the aura for 2 seconds and gain 50% damage reduction for the same duration (30 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.
Aura is activated once the ultimate's effect starts or has elapsed.
On Katarina, this augment will activate at the start of Death Lotus' channel.
notes: • On {{ci|Katarina}}, this augment will activate at the start of {{ais|R|Katarina}} channel.

name: Surge Field
description:
Upon casting your ultimate ability, you spawn a surge zone beneath you that has a 300 radius. While you are within the zone, you gain 50 ability haste and 40% bonus movement speed, and your damage dealt to enemy champions fires missiles at them that deal 20% of the triggering damage instance pre-mitigation as bonus magic damage. The missile effect cannot trigger from itself.
The zone lasts indefinitely as long as you stay within its radius. If you leave the zone's radius for the first time, it moves to your current location. Exiting the zone a second time causes it to disappear if you do not re-enter the area within 1.25 seconds.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Symphony of War
description:
Gain the Conqueror and Lethal Tempo keystone runes.
Conqueror
Adaptive force per stack changed to 1.8 – 3.3 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 3 – 5.5 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive).
Healing changed to ( 10% / 8%) of damage dealt.
Lethal Tempo
Bonus attack speed per stack changed to ( 13% – 18% / 8% – 12%) (based on level).
Maximum bonus attack speed changed to ( 78% – 108% / 48% – 72%) (based on level).
Removed: No longer empowers basic attacks at maximum stacks to fire a bolt that deals bonus adaptive damage.
New Effect: At maximum stacks, gain 50 bonus attack range and increase the attack speed cap to 10.
notes:
• {{ri|Conqueror}}
• * Adaptive force per stack changed to {{adaptive|3 to 5.5}}.
• * Healing changed to {{rd|10%|8%}} of damage dealt.
• {{ri|Lethal Tempo}}
• * Bonus attack speed per stack changed to {{rd|13 to 18|8 to 12|pp=true|key=%}}.
• ** Maximum bonus attack speed changed to {{rd|13*6 to 18*6|8*6 to 12*6|pp=true|key=%}}.
• * {{sbc|Removed:}} No longer empowers basic attacks at maximum stacks to fire a bolt that deals bonus adaptive damage.
• * {{sbc|New Effect:}} At maximum stacks, gain {{sti|attack range|50 bonus attack range}} and increase the attack speed cap to 10.

name: Tap Dancer
description: Basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions and minions grant 10 bonus movement speed, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking infinitely. Additionally, gain bonus attack speed equal to 10% total movement speed.

name: Third Times the Harm
description: Your basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions apply a mark to the target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. Every third attack on-hit against the marked target grants you a stack and deals bonus true damage equal to ( 6% / 3%) of the target's maximum health (+ ( 10 / 5) per stack you have).

name: Titan's Resolve
description:
You generate a stack of Juggernauting for each instance of damage you deal or take (excluding damage over time), lasting for 6 seconds and refreshing on subsequent damage dealt or taken. For every 7 stacks of Juggernauting, you gain 15 – 45 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 25 – 75 (based on level) Ability Power (Adaptive), 5 – 10 (based on level) bonus armor and bonus magic resistance, 10% increased size, and 8% tenacity.
Stacks expire one by one when the duration ends, with the decay rate being faster the more stacks you have.

name: Totentanz
description:
Replace a summoner spell with A Dance with Death.
A Dance with Death: Enter a contract with death for 6 seconds, opening a rift to the underworld beneath you and chaining you to it for the duration, during which you are also invulnerable and gain a minimum health threshold equal to 25 health. Over the first second, you become displacement immune and unable to act, and afterwards blink to the target location. For the remaining duration, you are inflicted with a health threshold equal to 100% – 1% (based on seconds elapsed) of your maximum health. If your current health is above the threshold at each interval, it is reduced to the maximum health ratio of the threshold.
After the first second, if you score a takedown against a champion within 3 seconds of damaging them before the end of the duration, your contract is fulfilled and this effect ends. The health threshold is removed, you are healed for 250 – 1000 (based on level) (+ 10 per 1 lethality) (+ 10 per 1 flat magic penetration), you blink back to the rift's location, the rift closes, and A Dance with Death's current cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds. Otherwise, if the duration expires, you fail your contract and are dragged into the rift, where you are executed upon arrival.
The health threshold cannot be modified nor exceeded by any means.
The pull towards the rift is a forced displacement.
While being pulled into the rift, the champion is rendered untargetable and unable to act.
notes:
• The health threshold cannot be {{tt|modified|By increases or decreases to maximum health}} nor {{tt|exceeded|By healing and health regeneration}} by any means.

name: Transmute: Chaos
description: Gain two completely random augments, excluding the other two offerings in your current assortment.

name: Triggered Inferno
description:
Your damaging basic attacks and abilities against at least one enemy champion unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a stack of Style for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 7 times. For each stack, gain 4.25% / 4.5% / 4.75% / 5% (based on level) bonus movement speed, up to a maximum of 29.75% / 31.5% / 33.25% / 35% (based on level).
Upon reaching maximum Style stacks, if an enemy champion is within range, you unleash a torrent of shots for 2.277 seconds. Over the first 2.013 seconds, you rapidly shoot at enemies within 600 units at sporadic times in 0.2-second intervals each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing 20 – 40 (based on level) (+ 40% AD) (+ 25% AP) physical damage with each shot, reduced by 75% against minions. Enemies below 30% of their maximum health are critically struck for「 double damage 」「 40 – 80 (based on level) (+ 80% AD) (+ 50% AP) physical damage 」(5 second cooldown). This effect ends prematurely if you become affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.
Style stacks are represented by grades (→→→→→→). The stacks are consumed at the end of the shooting effect. Shot damage applies life steal.
The Style stack count and corresponding symbol letter (see above) is indicated underneath your champion's model.
Samira cannot use Inferno Trigger during Triggered Inferno.
notes:
• The Style stack count and corresponding symbol letter (see above) is indicated underneath your champion's model.
• {{ci|Samira}} cannot use Inferno Trigger during Triggered Inferno.

name: Tripleshot
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that is unit-targeted and fires a missile, empowering the ability to fire its missiles at two additional enemies near the primary target. Subsequent hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.

name: Ultimate Awakening
description: Casting your ultimate ability resets the cooldowns of all your basic abilities and grants you 300 basic ability haste for 15 seconds (20 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.

name: Ultimate Revolution
description: Casting your ultimate ability resets its cooldown once its effect starts or has elapsed (75 second cooldown, reset upon death).

name: Ultra Hydra
description:
You can now purchase Tiamat, Profane Hydra, Ravenous Hydra, and Titanic Hydra in spite of the item limit imposed by Hydra. Purchasing a Legendary-tier Hydra item (excluding Stridebreaker) grants you a Tiamat for free.
Quest: Obtain Profane Hydra, Ravenous Hydra, and Titanic Hydra.
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Ultra Hydra.
While you have Ultra Hydra, you will be imposed with Hydra's item limit.
Hydra items cannot be sold while equipped with this augment.
While equipped with this augment, the passive and active effects of all Hydra items are no longer considered unique.
The Cleave passive effects of Tiamat, Profane Hydra, Ravenous Hydra, and Titanic Hydra will all trigger at the same time, creating multiple damaging area of effects with each attack if multiple Hydra items are in the inventory.
The cooldowns of the active effects are not shared; activating the active effect of one Hydra item does not place the others on cooldown.

name: Arcane Axiom
description: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them refunds 15% – 30% (based on level) of your ultimate ability's total cooldown.

name: Armored Impact
description: After casting an ability, your next basic attack on-hit within 10 seconds is empowered to deal 25 – 125 (based on level) (+ 220% bonus armor) bonus physical damage to the target and surrounding enemies.

name: BEES!!!
description:
Hitting an enemy champion with an ability causes you to toss a beehive at them over 1.1 seconds, which upon arrival explodes in a 425 radius to swarm enemy champions hit with bees for 2 seconds (15 – 10 (based on level) second cooldown). While being swarmed, targets are dealt「 75 – 140 (based on level) (+ 150% bonus AD) (+ 70% AP) magic damage 」「 18.75 – 35 (based on level) (+ 37.5% bonus AD) (+ 17.5% AP) magic damage every 0.5 seconds 」over the duration, applied on-hit effects at 40% effectiveness every 0.5 seconds (4 times total), and are slowed by 20%.
The damage dealt by this augment counts as persistent area damage, thus it is able to trigger spell effects.
notes: • The damage dealt by this augment counts as persistent area damage, thus it is able to trigger spell effects.

name: Big Brain
description: Gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 300% AP and lasts until destroyed. Shield is replenished upon respawn and every 70 seconds.

name: BONK!
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an empowered basic attack effect, further enhancing the attack to deal 30% increased damage to the target and 30% of its damage to nearby enemies.

name: Brass Blast
description:
Replace a summoner spell with Brass Blast.
Brass Blast - Active: You summon a large trumpet in front of you and begin charging for a minimum of 0.25 seconds and up to 2.5 seconds to increase Brass Blast's range, damage, and knock back distance over the first 1.5 seconds of the channel. While charging, you are slowed by 10% and can reactivate the spell. The recast occurs automatically if the charge reaches its maximum duration or is interrupted.
Recast: After a 0.5-second delay, blow into the trumpet, unleashing a blast of sound in a cone in the target direction that deals between 120 – 140 (based on level) (+ 70% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP) to 200 – 600 (based on level) (+ 115% bonus AD) (+ 80% AP) magic damage to enemy champions hit and knocking back all enemies hit up to 500 units over 0.75 seconds.
If the charge is interrupted, 50% of the cooldown is refunded.
Brass Blast uses quick casting by default, which requires the active to be held and the recast to occur on release.
The cone has an initial radius of 700 units.
Knock back speed is 1300.
notes:
• Brass Blast uses quick casting by default, which requires the active to be held and the recast to occur on release.
• The cone has an initial radius of 700 units.
• Knock back speed is 1300.

name: Bread And Butter
description: Your champion's first basic ability (Q) gains 100 ability haste.

name: Bread And Cheese
description: Your champion's third basic ability (E) gains 100 ability haste.

name: Bread And Jam
description: Your champion's second basic ability (W) gains 100 ability haste.

name: Celestial Body
description: Gain 1500 bonus health, but reduce your damage output by 10%.

name: Chain Reaction
description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a knock back effect, empowering the ability to trigger a chain reaction effect when displaced champions hit other champions or terrain within 200 units. If a knocked back champion collides with another enemy champion during their displacement, the champions they collided with are dealt 100 – 400 (based on level) magic damage and knocked up for 0.5 seconds. If they collide with terrain during their displacement, they will rebound to take 150 – 800 (based on level) magic damage and become knocked up for 0.75 seconds and stunned for 0.5 seconds. The knock up duration is increased to up to 1.1 seconds based on how long the ability's cooldown is.
If the upgraded ability is an ultimate, this effect deals 250% damage, increasing the champion collision damage to 250 – 1000 (based on level) and the terrain collision damage to 375 – 2000 (based on level).

name: CRIMSON COBALT
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering it to mark enemy champions damaged for 4 seconds. Your next basic attack on-hit against a marked target consumes the mark to deal 100 – 250 (based on level) (+ 70% bonus AD) (+ 35% AP) bonus magic damage and reduce the upgraded ability's current cooldown by 65% of its total cooldown.

name: Critical Healing
description: Your heals and shields now have a chance equal to your critical strike chance to increase in effectiveness by 40% (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

name: Critical Rhythm
description: Your critical strikes grant you 6% bonus attack speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 60%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.

name: Dawnbringer's Resolve
description:
Upon dropping below 50% maximum health, you are healed for「 30% of your maximum health 」「 2.5% of your maximum health every 0.25 seconds 」over 3 seconds (45 second cooldown, reset upon death).
This effect will still trigger if damage is taken while below 50% maximum health.
notes: • This effect will still trigger if damage is taken while below 50% maximum health.

name: Divine Intervention
description: Automatically cast Taric's Cosmic Radiance, calling down a protective star upon you that descends over 2.5 seconds. Afterwards, you and all allied champions within 400 units become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).

name: Donation
description: Gain 1750 upon acquiring this augment.

name: Double Time
description: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with two separate abilities within 4 seconds causes the second ability to deal bonus magic damage equal to 10% maximum mana and permanently increase your maximum mana by 25 (4 second cooldown per target).

name: Enchanting Butterflies
description:
Healing or shielding an allied champion causes a Butterfly to gather around you, up to 7. After collecting 7 Butterflies, your next instance of damage against an enemy champion fires all of your Butterflies at them, with the first one dealing 50 – 100 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) (+ 1% bonus health) (+ 3 per 1% heal and shield power) magic damage and all subsequent Butterflies dealing「 75% damage, 」「 37.5 – 75 (based on level) (+ 7.5% AP) (+ 0.75% bonus health) (+ 2.25 per 1% heal and shield power) magic damage, 」for a total damage of 275 – 550 (based on level) (+ 55% AP) (+ 5.5% bonus health) (+ 16.5 per 1% heal and shield power).
The Butteflies will orbit in a 150 radius around you.
notes: • The Butteflies will orbit in a 150 radius around you.

name: Endless Decimation
description:
While in combat, automatically cast an improved version of Darius' Decimate, winding up over 1.25 seconds to slash in a 460 radius around you. The slash deals 100 – 400 (based on level) (+ 60% AD) (+ 40% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown). Enemies within the 240 inner radius of the slash take「 50% damage. 」「 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 30% AD) (+ 20% AP) physical damage. 」Additionally, for each enemy champion hit along the outer edge, you heal for 18% of your missing health and the cooldown of this effect is reduced by 10%, down to a minimum of 3 seconds.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Ethereal Weapon
description: Your abilities apply on-hit effects (1 second cooldown per target).

name: Firebrand
description: Basic attacks on-hit apply a Burn for 5 seconds that deals bonus magic damage equal to「 0.4% of the target's maximum health per second. 」「 2% of the target's maximum health over the duration. 」This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

name: Flashy
description:
Your Flash now has 3 charges with a 2-second cooldown between casts (120 seconds recharge time for all 3 charges).
If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.

name: From Beginning to End
description:
Gain the Dark Harvest and First Strike keystone runes.
Dark Harvest
Base damage changed to 50 – 100 (based on level).
Damage per soul changed to 20.
Bonus AD ratio changed to 35% bonus AD.
AP ratio changed to 25% AP.
Gain 8 Souls if this is not your first augment.
First Strike
Base gold increased to 20 from 15 (ARAM override value).
Bonus damage increased to 10% from 7%.
notes:
• {{ri|Dark Harvest}}
• * Base damage changed to 50 to 100.
• * Damage per soul changed to 20.
• * Bonus AD ratio changed to 35% bonus AD.
• * AP ratio changed to 25% AP.
• * Gain 8 Souls if this is not your first augment.
• {{ri|First Strike}}
• * Base gold increased to 20 gold from 15 gold (ARAM override value).
• * Bonus damage increased to 10% from 7%.

name: From Downtown
description:
Quest: Hit enemy champions with abilities while located at least 600 units away from them (at the time of the hit) 15 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, hitting enemy champions with abilities while located at least 600 units away from them at the time of the hit fires a meteor to their current location, which upon landing deals 75 – 200 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown per target per cast instance). The meteor's damage and radius are increased based on your distance to the target at the time of the ability hit, increasing its damage by 0% – 230% and setting its radius to 150 – 1708.6 units.
Maximum meteor damage is 172.5 – 460 (based on level) (+ 115% bonus AD) (+ 46% AP).

name: Get Excited
description: Scoring a champion takedown grants you 100% bonus movement speed and 15% total attack speed for 4 seconds.

name: Get Jinxed
description:
Replace a summoner spell with Get Jinxed!.
Get Jinxed!: Summon a rocket from beneath you that immediately winds up over 1.5 seconds. Afterwards, it propels forward in the direction you targeted at the time of cast, causing you to ride the rocket for up to 15 seconds. The rocket automatically navigates your movement along the way and you are able to steer its trajectory in the direction of your cursor, with a slow turn rate that increases over time. After being in flight for 2 seconds, the rocket decelerates to a very slow speed for 0.6 seconds before receiving a massive boost in speed, maintaining its increased speed for the remainder of the flight.
Upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain, the rocket explodes in a 400 radius, ending the ride and dealing 20 – 80 (based on level) (+ 12% bonus AD) (+ 8% AP) (+ 3% of target's missing health) physical damage to enemies hit (including structures). This damage is increased by 0% – 700% (based on distance the rocket travelled), up to 160 – 640 (based on level) (+ 96% bonus AD) (+ 64% AP) (+ 24% of target's missing health) physical damage.
During the initial windup and while riding the rocket, you become ghosted and are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act.
The rocket has a collision radius of 50 units on terrain and 150 units against champions.
Once propelled, the rocket travels at an initial speed of 250 for the first 0.5 seconds, before accelerating to 750. After another 1.5 seconds, it decelerates to a near halt at a speed of 50 for 0.6 seconds, then instantly accelerates to 1400 for the remainder of its flight.
notes:
• The rocket has a collision radius of 50 units on terrain and 150 units against champions.
• Once propelled, the rocket travels at an initial speed of 250 for the first 0.5 seconds, before accelerating to 750. After another 1.5 seconds, it decelerates to a near halt at a speed of 50 for 0.6 seconds, then instantly accelerates to 1400 for the remainder of its flight.

name: Growth Spurt
description:
Replace a summoner spell with Growth Spurt.
Growth Spurt: Enlarge yourself, causing you to knock up enemies within 400 units for 1 second. For the next 7 seconds, you gain 300 (+ 20% maximum health) bonus health and 50% increased size.

name: Heavy Is The Crown
description:
Your total movement speed is now reduced by 5% after 1.5 seconds of entering combat. In return, you gain 10 bonus attack damage and 25 ability power, and your bonus attack damage, ability power, and total attack speed are increased by 10%. The movement speed reduction is removed after 7 seconds of being out of combat.
Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion generates a stack of Burden. For each stack, the bonus attack damage, ability power, and total attack speed are increased by 5%, and the total movement speed reduction is increased by 2.5%. The movement speed reduction is capped at 50%. Lose 50% of stacks on death.

name: Impassable
description:
Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment keystone runes.
Aftershock
Cooldown reduced to 15 seconds from 20.
Glacial Augment
Cooldown reduced to 15 seconds from 25.

name: It's Critical
description: Grants 50% critical strike chance.

name: It's Killing Time
description: Upon casting your ultimate ability, you apply Zed's Death Mark to all enemy champions (8 second cooldown). The mark stores 40% of all post-mitigation damage you deal to the affected target, detonating after 5 seconds to deal true damage equal to the damage stored against them.

name: Jeweled Bracelet
description:
Your ultimate ability can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical strike damage) damage. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
Jeweled Bracelet has no effect if the damage of the ultimate ability can already critically strike.
notes: • Jeweled Bracelet has no effect if the damage of the ultimate ability can already critically strike.

name: Lil' Extra Help
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an effect which empowers your basic attacks for a duration, further enhancing the attacks by granting you ( 150 / 100) bonus attack range and ( 75% / 40%) bonus attack speed while the effect is active.

name: Magic Missile
description: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with an ability fires 3 missiles at them that each deal true damage equal to 0.33% of the target's maximum health, increased to up to 1% based on distance travelled (maximum damage reached at 1000 units). This effect can only trigger once every 6 seconds from the same cast.

name: Marksmage
description: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 75% AP.

name: Mercy's Strike
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to enhance your next basic attack. The enhanced attack has 300 bonus range, gains 75% bonus attack speed, and deals bonus magic damage equal to 3% (+ 2% per 10% heal and shield power) of the target's maximum health. If the target is a turret, the damage is modified to 2.5% of the target's maximum health bonus magic damage.

name: Minionmancer
description: Your pets deal 40% increased damage as well as gain 40% bonus health and size.

name: Nature is Healing
description:
Upon entering a patch of brush, you are healed for「 40 – 300 (based on level) (+ 15% of your missing health) 」「 6.67 – 50 (based on level) (+ 2.5% of your missing health) every 0.25 seconds 」over 1.5 seconds (20 second cooldown per brush patch).
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Nightstalking
description: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them renders you invisible for 1.5 seconds, during which you also gain 40% bonus movement speed. Attacking or casting abilites ends the stealth immediately.

name: OK Boomerang
description: Automatically cast an improved version of Sivir's Boomerang Blade at the closest nearby enemy champion within 1250 units, dealing 40 – 200 (based on level) (+ 30% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) adaptive damage to enemies hit (10 second cooldown).

name: One Hit Wonder
description: Modifies one of your champion's abilities to have its cooldown no longer be affected by ability haste. In return, the ability now deals 7.5% increased damage per 10 ability haste you have.

name: Outlaw's Grit
description: Dashing or blinking grants 12 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 15 seconds, stacking up to 5 times for a total of 60 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers.

name: Overextender
description:
Your launch with the Cannon Launcher is now empowered, increasing the launch range by 12,000 units and the impact damage by 50%, as well as the travel speed by a significant amount. Additionally, your Recall is now functional and is upgraded to Empowered Recall.
This augment is only available on the Butcher's Bridge map.
Total launch range is 18,500 units, reduced to 16,500 after your team's Outer turret is destroyed. Increased impact damage is 180 – 690 (based on level) magic damage.

name: Overflow
description: Your abilities' mana costs are doubled, but you also gain 10% (+ 0.5% per 100 maximum mana) increased damage as well as self and outgoing healing and shielding.

name: Pat On The Back
description:
Whenever you are within 200 units of an allied champion, they pat you on the back, granting you a 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus movement speed) shield and 30% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds (9 second cooldown). Subsequent passes only refresh the duration of the effects.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Pentakill: DOOM
description: Your champion's ultimate ability gains 20 ability haste and 10% increased damage, healing, and shielding.

name: Pentakill: HEAVY
description: Your champion's first basic ability (Q) gains 20 ability haste and 10% increased damage, healing, and shielding.

name: Pentakill: POWER
description: Your champion's second basic ability (W) gains 20 ability haste and 10% increased damage, healing, and shielding.

name: Pentakill: THRASH
description: Your champion's third basic ability (E) gains 20 ability haste and 10% increased damage, healing, and shielding.

name: Phenomenal Evil
description:
Gain Veigar's Phenomenal Evil Power.
Phenomenal Evil Power: Generate a permanent stack of Phenomenal Evil each time you damage an enemy champion with ability damage. This effect cannot trigger more than once every second globally and once every 3 seconds from the same cast instance. For each stack, gain 1 ability power.
If this is not your first augment, start with 40 Phenomenal Evil stacks, granting you 40 ability power.
The 40 bonus stacks for selecting this augment as not your first augment are given once the first stack is earned.
notes: • The 40 bonus stacks for selecting this augment as not your first augment are given once the first stack is earned.

name: Pinball
description:
Your Mark is empowered to instead throw a pinball, which deals 100 – 500 (based on level) bonus true damage and ricochets off of terrain that it collides with. Each time the pinball ricochets, its remaining travel distance is reset, it increases in radius by 25%, deals 20% increased damage, and reduces Mark's remaining cooldown by 30%. The pinball can ricochet up to 4 times, for a maximum radius increase of 100% and a damage increase of 80%. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

name: Porcupine
description: You build up a burst of needles from within you when taking damage from enemy champions, storing up to 400 – 3900 (based on level) pre-mitigation damage taken. After reaching the maximum damage stored, you consume the stored damage to burst the needles outward in a 400 radius, dealing 75 – 200 (based on level) (+ 125% bonus armor) (+ 125% bonus magic resistance) physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.

name: Pressure Cooker
description:
Surrounds you in flames, causing you to apply a Burn every second to enemy champions within 300 units for 3 seconds that deals magic damage equal to「 0.5% of your maximum health per second. 」「 1.5% of your maximum health over the duration. 」This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.
Additionally, you are assigned with quests that require you to deal a certain amount of damage with the Burn effect against enemy champions. There are three quest tiers, and each completed tier grants you a reward that improves Pressure Cooker's effect.
Tier
Quest
Reward
1
Deal a total of 1500 damage with the Burn.
Increase the Burn's range to 500 units.
2
Deal an additional total of 12,000 damage with the Burn (13,500 damage total).
Double the rate at which the Burn is inflicted, applying two stacks of the effect to targets every second.
3
Deal an additional total of 15,000 damage with the Burn (28,500 damage total).
Increase the Burn's range to 600 units.

name: Pursuit of Haste
description:
Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are two quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with ability haste on the ability.
Tier
Quest
Reward
1
Hit an enemy champion with the ability 10 times.
Reduce the cooldown of the ability equivalent to 80 ability haste.
2
Hit an enemy champion with the ability 20 additional times (30 hits total).
Reduce the cooldown of the ability equivalent to an additional 80 ability haste (160 ability haste total).

name: Pursuit of Power
description:
Quest: Hit an enemy champion with a specific ability 10 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the damage of the ability by 30%.

name: Quest: Steel Your Heart
description:
Quest: Obtain Heartsteel and accumulate over 300 bonus health from Colossal Consumption.
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the bonus health gained from Heartsteel's Colossal Consumption by 200%.

name: Quickstep
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to cause you to dash up to 350 units towards your cursor.

name: Ravenous Bind
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a immobilizing or grounding effect, empowering the ability to deal 15 – 90 (based on level) (+ 10% AP) (+ 0.5% of your maximum health) magic damage to affected targets and heal you for 75 – 300 (based on level) (+ 5% AP) (+ 12% bonus health). The heal is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is.

name: Recoil
description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering it to deal 25% increased damage and on-cast cause you to dash 450 units opposite the direction you are facing.
Dash speed is 1500.
notes: • Dash speed is 1500.

name: Recursion
description: Grants 60 ability haste.

name: Rejuvenation
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to heal you for 30 – 100 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) (+ 5% bonus health). This is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is, for a maximum heal of 45 – 150 (based on level) (+ 37.5% bonus AD) (+ 22.5% AP) (+ 7.5% bonus health).

name: Reload
description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, causing basic attacks on-hit during the ability to reduce its remaining cooldown by 0.15 – 0.35 (based on level) seconds.
This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

name: Salvation
description:
Upon dropping below 50% of your maximum health, you unleash a shockwave that expands from your location over 1200 units, dealing 100 – 500 (based on level) (+ 125% bonus AD) (+ 75% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and healing you and allied champions hit for 200 – 550 (based on level) (+ 200% bonus AD) (+ 120% AP) (90 second cooldown). Enemy champions hit within the first 600 units of the shockwave are knocked back 450 – 100 (based on distance travelled) units.
This effect will still trigger if damage is taken while below 50% maximum health.
notes: • This effect will still trigger if damage is taken while below 50% maximum health.

name: Sap Magic
description: Your next basic attack on-hit is empowered to deal 80 – 300 (based on level) (+ 5% bonus health) bonus physical damage and heal you for 50 – 250 (based on level) (+ 8% maximum health) (20 second cooldown). Casting an ability reduces the cooldown of this effect by 3 seconds.

name: Scopier Weapons
description: Gain ( 200 / 100) bonus attack range.

name: Searing Dawn
description:
Gain Leona's Sunlight.
Sunlight: Your damaging abilities mark enemies, causing them to take 40 – 200 (based on level) bonus magic damage from your ally's next basic attack or ability hit against them (0.75-second cooldown per target).

name: Shark Bait
description:
Upon taking fatal damage, you become a Shark Bait, causing you to enter a zombie state for 3.5 seconds, during which your movement speed is set to a static 400, you gain ghosting, and enemies within 400 units of you are slowed by 40%. At the end of the duration, a massive shark emerges from beneath you that lets out a powerful chomp (400 radius), dealing 120 – 350 (based on level) (+ 30% of target's missing health) magic damage to all enemies within the area and knocking them up for 1 second.
While under the zombie state, you are able to move and become invulnerable, untargetable, and immune to crowd control, but you are also rendered unable to declare basic attacks, cast abilities, use summoner spells, and activate items.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Shark Tempest
description:
Your Mark is empowered to circle sharks around it in a 300 radius, dealing 100 – 200 (based on level) magic damage to enemies it passes through as it travels and slowing targets hit by 40% for 1 second. If the missile hits an enemy champion, the sharks circle around their location in a 425 radius instead for 3 seconds, dealing「 30 – 90 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) magic damage every second 」「 90 – 270 (based on level) (+ 75% bonus AD) (+ 45% AP) total magic damage over the duration 」to enemies within the area and slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
This augment is currently disabled.
The damage dealt by this augment counts as area damage, thus it is able to trigger spell effects.
notes: • The damage dealt by this augment counts as area damage, thus it is able to trigger spell effects.

name: Shrink Engine
description:
Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, gain 8 ability haste and 1% bonus movement speed, and reduce your size by 4%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.
Size reduction is capped at 80% (20 stacks).

name: Shrink Ray
description: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the target's damage dealt by 15% for 3 seconds, refreshing with each hit. Their size is also reduced significantly for the duration.

name: Skilled Sniper
description: Hitting an enemy champion with a basic ability while located at least 600 units away from them at the time of the hit reduces its current cooldown by 80% of its total cooldown, modified to 65% for damage over time abilities.

name: Snap Back
description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability with a recast. Using the recast causes you to blink back to your original casting position of the ability and explode to deal 100 – 300 (based on level) (+ 20% AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.
This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.

name: Snowblast
description:
Empowers the Dash spell from Mark to deal 100% increased damage and upon arrival cause you to knock up the target for 0.5 seconds and knock back nearby enemies. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste. 
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Sonata
description:
Alternate between automatically casting a modified version of Sona's Aria of Perseverance and modified Song of Celerity, with the former being cast first (10 second cooldown).
Aria of Perseverance: Heal yourself for 60 (+ 60% AP) and send out a tone to the most wounded allied champion within 1000 units that heals them for the same amount. Additionally, generate an aura that grants you and tagged allied champions a 80 (+ 40% AP) shield for 1.5 seconds.
Song of Celerity: Gain 30% bonus movement speed for 7 seconds. If you take damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed. Additionally, generate an aura that grants tagged allied champions 20% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds.

name: Soul Eater
description:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 30 bonus health, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance).
If this is not your first augment, gain 300 bonus health.

name: Soul Siphon
description:
Heal for 12% of the post-mitigation damage dealt by your critical strikes. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
Any damage from Critical strikes will heal, including those from non-basic attack sources ( Talon's Noxian Diplomacy, Ashe's Volley, etc).
notes: • Any damage from Critical strikes will heal, including those from non-basic attack sources ({{cai|Noxian Diplomacy|Talon}}, {{cai|Volley|Ashe}}, etc<!--might heal from cosmetic crits?-->).

name: Stats on Stats!
description: Gain 3 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils.

name: Still Here
description: Gain 0% – 200% (based on your missing health) bonus attack speed and 0% – 35% (based on your missing health) life steal.

name: Take'em Down Down Down
description:
Basic attacks on-hit and ability hits against enemy champions apply a stack for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 5 times, and deal ( 5 – 30 / 2.5 – 15) (based on level) (+ ( 35% / 17.5%) bonus AD) (+ ( 15% / 7.5%) AP) bonus magic damage plus ( 1 – 6 / 0.5 – 3) (based on level) (+ ( 7% / 3.5%) bonus AD) (+ ( 3% / 1.5%) AP) additional magic damage per stack on the target.
The fifth stack against a target consumes them all to deal additional magic damage equal to ( 17% / 8.5%) of the target's missing health and heal you for ( 67% / 33.5%) of the post-mitigation damage dealt.

name: Tank Engine
description: Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, increase your maximum health and size by 5%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.

name: Terrain'd
description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that spawns terrain, empowering the ability to deal 20 – 180 (based on level) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies near the terrain. This damage is increased「 by 200% 」「 to 60 – 540 (based on level) (+ 60% AP) 」if the ability is an ultimate.
The damage dealt by this augment counts as area damage, thus it is able to trigger spell effects.
notes: • The damage dealt by this augment counts as area damage, thus it is able to trigger spell effects.

name: Terror
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to fear all enemies within 450 units of you for 1.75 seconds (30 second cooldown).

name: The Boom and the Bass
description: After casting an ability, your next basic attack on-hit within 6 seconds is empowered to gain 200% bonus attack speed, deal ( 50 – 200 / 25 – 100) (based on level) (+ ( 50% / 25%) bonus AD) (+ ( 30% / 15%) AP) bonus magic damage, and grant you 75% – 150% (based on level) bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds.

name: Thread the Needle
description: Grants 18% armor penetration and magic penetration.

name: Tickle Monster
description: Convert all of your bonus attack damage into bonus attack speed at a rate of 1.75% bonus attack speed per 1 bonus attack damage. Additionally, your basic attacks deal 5 – 50 (based on level) bonus magic damage on-hit.

name: Tooth Fairy
description:
When you deal post-mitigation damage to an enemy champion equal to or more than 25% of their maximum health within 2.5 seconds, they drop a Tooth on the ground (4 second cooldown per target). You can pick up this Tooth by moving over it, granting you a Dental Records stack. For each stack, you gain 3 lethality and flat magic penetration.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Transmute: Prismatic
description: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment.

name: Upgrade Infinity Edge
description:
Upgrades Infinity Edge, empowering it to gain Sword of the Divine's Excoriate. Additionally, gain 500.
Excoriate: Gain a random amount of bonus critical strike damage that scales up to 50% of your critical strike chance, with the value of this amount changing every 0.25 seconds.

name: Upgrade Ravenous Hydra
description: Upgrades Ravenous Hydra, increasing its life steal stat to 20% and empowering Cleave to trigger its effect on ability hits against enemies (1 second cooldown per ability). Additionally, gain 500.

name: Upgrade Sheen
description: Upgrades all Spellblade items, empowering the passive effect to deal additional bonus physical damage equal to 4% of the target's maximum health and heal you for 3.5% of the target's maximum health. Additionally, gain 250.

name: Upgrade Stormsurge
viName: Nâng Cấp Quyền Trượng Bão Tố
description:
Upgrades Stormsurge, empowering Squall to strike the area around the primary target with lightning (350 radius) after its delay, dealing magic damage equal to 10% (+ 2% per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health to enemies hit. Enemy champions hit by the blast are also inflicted with Squall, causing lightning to strike the area around them after the same delay, dealing the same damage. Subsequent blasts from these secondary targets do not inflict Squall to champions hit. Additionally, gain 500.
Squall's electric field from the target dying before the lightning strike does not apply this augment's effects.

name: Upgrade Sundered Sky
description: Upgrades Sundered Sky, empowering Lightshield Strike with an increased heal health ratio of 9% of your missing health and a reduced cooldown of 5 seconds. Additionally, gain 500.

name: Vulnerability
description:
Damage dealt by items and damage over time effects can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical strike damage) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).
The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects.(bug)
Vulnerability has no effect if the source of the item damage or damage or time effect can already critically strike.
notes:
• The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects.{{bug}}
• Vulnerability has no effect if the source of the item damage or damage or time effect can already critically strike.

name: Warlock Juicebox
description: Gain 10% (+ 3% per 100 AP) omnivamp.

name: Weapon of Destiny
description:
Upon acquiring this augment, the first eligible Legendary item in your inventory is granted the Weapon of Destiny passive effect.
Weapon of Destiny: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them permanently increases the gold value of all upgradeable stats on this item by exactly 200, shared equally among them. This item can no longer be sold.
Weapon of Destiny scans each item slot in your inventory (from slots 1-6) for an eligible Legendary item, granting the passive effect to the first eligible item that is found.
Statistics' gold value and eligible stats to be increased for the item:
50 per 1 point of ability haste.
20 per 1 point of ability power.
33.3 per 1 point of attack damage.
25 per 1% of attack speed.
20 per 1 point of armor.
20 per 1 point of magic resistance.
40 per 1% of critical strike chance.
166.6 per 1% of critical strike damage.
50 per 1 point of lethality.
66.6 per 1 point of flat magic penetration.
66.6 per 1% of percentage armor penetration.
111.1 per 1% of percentage magic penetration.
40 per 1% of life steal.
40 per 1% of omnivamp.
66.6 per 1% of percentage movement speed.
50 per 1% of heal and shield power.
2.6 per 1 point of health.
1 per 1 point of mana.
Weapon of Destiny's interaction with the Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap augment:
If Weapon of Destiny upgrades Rabadon's Deathcap or Zhonya's Hourglass, and the quest is completed afterward, the upgrade is not transferred to Wooglet's Witchcap as it is not a Legendary item. Instead, the number of takedowns/stat upgrades from the previously upgraded item is stored and the upgrade is transferred to the first eligible Legendary item in the inventory, or to the next Legendary item that is purchased if none are available.
PENDING FOR TEST: Weapon of Destiny's interaction with the Quest: Icathia's Fall and Quest: Urf's Champion augments.
