name: Wee Woo Wee Woo
description: Gain 0% – 50% (based on target ally's missing health) bonus movement speed while facing toward nearby allied champions, lingering for 2 seconds after no longer facing them. Your heals and shields are also increased by 0% – 50% (based on target's missing health).

name: With Haste
description: Grants bonus movement speed equal to 70% ability haste.

name: Yowch, My Coins!
description: Enemy champions that you score a takedown against drop 6 – 10 (based on level) coins, with each coin landing 500 units away from the location of their death and lasting 10 seconds. You or allied champions can collect the coins by moving over them, granting 15 for each coin collected.

name: ADAPt
description: Convert all of your bonus attack damage into ability power at a rate of 1 ability power per 0.6 bonus attack damage. Additionally, increase your ability power by 15%.

name: Adaptive Ward
description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to grant you 7 – 12 (based on level) bonus armor or bonus magic resistance for 6 seconds when it hits an enemy champion (4 second cooldown). This effect can stack up to a number of times.
The resistance type granted is based on the target's adaptive type: bonus armor for physical and bonus magic resistance for magic.

name: Blue Barrier
description: Gain a shield equal to 200% – 450% (based on level) of mana spent for 1.5 seconds. Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields. Each shield instance is capped at a strength of 300 – 800 (based on level).

name: Blunt Force
description: Increases attack damage by 20%.

name: Bolstered
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a shield effect, increasing the strength of the ability's shield by 0% – 60% (based on target's missing health).

name: Deft
description: Grants 60% bonus attack speed.

name: Dive Bomber
description: Upon death, you explode to deal true damage equal to 20% of the target's maximum health to enemies within 500 units.

name: Don't Blink
description: Deal 1% increased damage per 10 movement speed you have more than the target.

name: Don't Change the Channel
description: For every second that you channel an ability, you gain a 50 – 200 (based on level) (+ 50% AD) (+ 25% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield. The shield quickly decays once you stop channeling.

name: Erosion
description: Each instance of damage dealt to an enemy reduces their armor and magic resistance by 1.5% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20 times for a total of 30% resistances reduction.

name: EscAPADe
description: Convert all of your ability power into bonus attack damage at a rate of 1 bonus attack damage per 1.66 ability power. Additionally, increase your total attack damage by 15%.

name: Escape Plan
description:
Upon dropping below 35% maximum health, gain a shield for 65% of your maximum health for 5.5 seconds, during which you also gain 150% bonus movement speed and have reduced size (75 second cooldown). The shield and bonus movement speed decay over the duration.
This effect will still trigger if damage is taken while below 35% maximum health.
notes: • This effect will still trigger if damage is taken while below 35% maximum health.

name: Firefox
description: Automatically cast a modified version of Ahri's Fox-Fire, gaining 25% bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds and conjuring 3 flames that orbit you clockwise for up to 2.5 seconds at a radius of 150 units. The flames will fly toward the nearest visible enemies within 550 units, dealing 35 – 160 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD (+ 25% AP) adaptive damage, reduced to「 10.5 – 48 (based on level) (+ 7.5% bonus AD (+ 7.5% AP) 」「 30% of the original damage 」for enemies hit by subsequent flames from the same cast (7 second cooldown).

name: First-Aid Kit
description: Grants 20% heal and shield power.

name: Flash 2
description: Replace a summoner spell with Flash. Additionally, gain 70 summoner spell haste.

name: Flashbang
description:
Using Flash creates an explosion around the blink location that deals 70 – 240 (based on level) (+ 70% AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 35% for 1.25 seconds. Additionally, the cooldown of your Flash resets upon your death.
This augment cannot be rolled unless you have the Flashy augment. If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.

name: Flow of Spirit
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering its cast to grant you 60% – 120% (based on level) bonus attack speed for 4 seconds.

name: Forged By The Master
description:
Increases the damage dealt by your item effects and augments by 45%.
This augment is currently disabled.

name: Fruitify
description: Enemy champions that you score a takedown against drop 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 (based on level) Honeyfruit at the location of their death for 10 seconds. You and allied champions can step over a Honeyfruit to consume it, healing for 6% of maximum health and restoring 6% of maximum mana as well as 10 energy and Fury (if applicable).

name: Gift of the Drowned
description: Convert all of your bonus health into lethality at a rate of「 0.05 lethality per 1 bonus health. 」「 5 lethality per 100 bonus health. 」Additionally, gain 10 – 25 (based on level) lethality.

name: Goredrink
description: Gain 15% omnivamp.

name: Guilty Pleasure
description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion heals you for 30 – 250 (based on level) (+ 1.5% maximum health) (5 second cooldown per cast instance).

name: Hands off the Talent
description: Basic attacks against enemies hit farther than 75% of your total attack range deal 15% bonus AD (+ 20% AP) bonus physical damage.

name: Heavy Hitter
description: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 3.5% of your maximum health.

name: Hextech Soul
description: Grants the Hextech Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

name: Homeguard
description: Gain 100% bonus movement speed. This bonus is lost for 6 seconds after taking damage.

name: Ice Cold
description: Your slowing effects reduce the movement speed of targets by an additional 75.

name: Infernal Soul
description: Grants the Infernal Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

name: It's Go Time
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, empowering the ability to grant 25% – 45% (based on level) bonus movement speed for the effect's duration.

name: Juiced
description: Basic attacks against enemy champions deal bonus magic damage on-hit equal to ( 7% / 5.6%) of your maximum mana. This damage can critically strike for (100% + 30%) bonus damage.

name: Kill Secured
description: Gain 60% bonus movement speed towards enemy champions below 40% of their maximum health.

name: Leg Day
description: Gain 50 bonus movement speed and 50% slow resist.

name: Lich Brain
description: Gain 30 (+ 4% bonus health) ability power.

name: Light 'em Up!
description: Basic attacks on-hit generate a stack, up to 4. The fourth stack consumes them all to quickly launch 4 missiles at the target that each deal 11 – 80 (based on level) (+ 35% bonus AD) (+ 19% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit, for a total of 44 – 320 (based on level) (+ 140% bonus AD) (+ 76% AP).

name: Lonely Warrior
description: For each enemy champion within 600 units of you, gain 15% bonus attack speed and 10 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance.

name: Mighty Shield
description: Gain 40 – 100 (based on level) adaptive force for 3 seconds upon gaining a shield (5 second cooldown).

name: Mind to Matter
description:
Grants bonus health equal to 50% maximum mana.
Maximum bonus health granted by this effect is capped at 99,999 bonus health.
notes: • Maximum bonus health granted by this effect is capped at 99,999 bonus health.

name: Mountain Soul
description: Grants the Mountain Dragon Soul, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

name: No Mana, No Problem
viName: Hết Năng Lượng, Không Vấn Đề
description: Convert all of the mana you gain from items into ability power at a rate of 0.8 ability power per 10 mana from items. Additionally, increase your ability power by 15%.

name: Ocean Soul
description: Grants the Ocean Dragon Soul, which has a modified base heal value of 100, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

name: Poltergeist
description:
Replace a summoner spell with Poltergeist.
Poltergeist: Casts both Barrier and Ghost on yourself, both lasting 5 seconds and with the former granting a shield for 110 – 440 (based on level) and the latter granting 30% bonus movement speed.

name: Purist - Caster
description: Convert all of your bonus attack speed into ability haste at a rate of 0.65 ability haste per 1% bonus attack speed. Additionally, your abilities' total cooldowns are reduced by 10%.

name: Scoped Weapons
description: Gain ( 75 / 50) bonus attack range.

name: Shadow Runner
description: After dashing, blinking, or exiting stealth, gain 300 bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

name: Siphon
description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to heal you for 30% of its post-mitigation damage dealt to enemy champions.

name: Slap Around
description:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 6 bonus Attack Damage or 10 Ability Power (Adaptive), stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Lose 50% of stacks on death.
If the bonus attack damage and the ability power of the unit are equal, the stat granted is always bonus AD.(unexpected)
notes: If the bonus attack damage and the ability power of the unit are equal, the stat granted is always bonus AD.{{bug|2}}

name: Snowday
description:
Your Mark deals 100% increased damage and has its cooldown reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.

name: Sonic Boom
description: Granting a buff, heal, or shield to your ally deals 30 – 150 (based on level) true damage to enemies within 450 units of them and slows targets by 30% for 2 seconds (2 second cooldown).

name: Sound Barrier
description: Your shields on yourself or allies grant ghosting and 20% – 40% (based on level) (+ 0.5% per 1% heal and shield power) bonus movement speed that decays over 1.5 seconds (1.5-second cooldown per target).

name: Spin Me Right Round
description:
Replace a summoner spell with Akshan's Heroic Swing (10 second cooldown, starts post-effect).
Heroic Swing - Active: You can activate Heroic Swing three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and you can use the third cast only after 0.5 seconds of the second cast. An attack or movement command may be inputted to use the second and third casts.
First Cast: Fire a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first terrain hit for 2 seconds. Heroic Swing's second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or you become immobilized, grounded, or polymorphed within the duration, Heroic Swing is cancelled and placed on full cooldown.
Second Cast: Swing around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to your facing direction, stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, fire at the nearest visible enemy within your attack range (minimum 400 units) every 0.231 seconds to deal them 15 – 75 (based on level) (+ 15% AD) × (1 + 0.3 per 100% bonus attack speed) physical damage and apply on-hit effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness. The dash will be interrupted if you are affected by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.
Third Cast: End the swing by jumping to the target location and fire one last shot at a nearby visible enemy.

name: Spin To Win
description:
Your spinning abilities deal 30% increased damage and have their cooldown reduced equivalent to 30 ability haste. The damage amplifier is increased to 50% for ultimate abilities.
